gloss: to burst out laughing; to roar with laughter

definitions.gloss: to burst out laughing; to roar with laughter
definitions.explanation: To laugh loudly and uncontrollably. Originally meant a large group laughing together, but in modern usage commonly refers to any instance of explosive, unrestrained laughter.

examples.japanese: {観客|かんきゃく}が{爆笑|ばくしょう}した。
あの{動画|どうが}を{見|み}て{爆笑|ばくしょう}してしまった。
examples.english: I burst out laughing watching that video.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{話|はなし}がおもしろすぎて、{電車|でんしゃ}の{中|なか}で{爆笑|ばくしょう}してしまった。
examples.english: His story was so funny that I burst out laughing on the train.

examples.japanese: あの{芸人|げいにん}は{会場|かいじょう}を{爆笑|ばくしょう}の{渦|うず}に{巻|ま}き{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: That comedian had the entire venue in stitches.

notes:
Originally, {爆笑|ばくしょう} strictly meant a large group of people laughing simultaneously (the {爆|ばく} = "explosion" suggesting laughter spreading through a crowd). However, modern usage has shifted, and it now commonly describes any intense, explosive laughter — even by one person. This semantic shift is noted by language purists but widely accepted.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爆笑|ばくしょう}を{誘|さそ}う: to elicit roaring laughter
- {爆笑|ばくしょう}の{渦|うず}: whirlpool of laughter
- {爆笑|ばくしょう}もの: something hilarious
- {爆笑|ばくしょう}エピソード: hilarious anecdote
- {大|おお}{爆笑|ばくしょう}: huge burst of laughter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {笑|わら}う: to laugh — general-purpose laughing
- {大笑|おおわら}いする: to laugh heartily — loud laughter, slightly less explosive
- {吹|ふ}き{出|だ}す: to burst out laughing — sudden laughter, often from trying not to laugh
